name: OneRobotics (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: OneRobotics (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells home robotics system products and other home robot products and accessories in Japan, Europe, North America, and rest of the world. The company develops SwitchBot App that enables users to achieve centralized control of home robotic system products for intelligent home living experience. It offers dexterous hand-mimic robots, such as lock robots, curtain robots and finger robots, and enhanced mobile robots, such as multitasking household robots, and sports robots; perception and decision-making systems, including smart hubs, smart sensors, and smart cameras; and other smart home products and services, such as light tools, power tools, and smart home appliances under the SwitchBot and Acemate brand names. The company also provides various accessories, including cleaning supplies, power solutions, smart home control accessories, and security add-ons; and cloud storage services to utilize digital archiving for footage captured by its smart cameras. Its products are used in home automation, domestic chores, AI butler, elderly care, security, and energy management applications. The company sells its products to end consumers, retailers, and distributors. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
